calls.video_title: Should You Buy Alibaba Stock Before the Huge Investor Update? | BABA Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: BUY, first tracked - buying opportunity before the 19 Nov earnings update: stock down 36% from above $175 to $94 (2026 low) while EPS estimates rise; fwd P/E just 10 (was 25 earlier in 2026), EPS growth ~27%/yr expected, AI revenue growing triple-digit %. Buy before earnings for higher risk/reward, or wait until after the print for lower risk - either way a buy.
calls.base_case: EPS growth ~27%/yr for next several years; AI revenue accelerating triple-digit %; balance sheet strong - $63B+ cash/short-term investments vs under $35B long-term debt.
calls.bull_case: AI revenue acceleration plus proprietary chips lower AI costs; valuation re-rates from fwd P/E 10 toward earlier 25.
calls.bear_case: Margins in long decline - operating margin from ~30% to low single digits, CFO/sales from 50%+ to single digits; earnings growth is capex-funded, not organic; revenue growth slowed.
